title: Music From C418
description: Replaces all soundtracks ingame with the C418 soundtracks.
body:
# Music From C418

Bring back the classic atmosphere of Minecraft with **Music From C418**.
This resource pack replaces Minecraft's modern soundtrack with the iconic music created by C418, restoring the nostalgic feeling of older versions of the game.

Whether you're building, mining, exploring, or just sitting in your world at sunset, this pack keeps the soundtrack focused on the timeless tracks that made Minecraft feel special.

## ✨ Features

* Replaces modern Minecraft music with classic C418 tracks
* Keeps the nostalgic alpha/beta vibe alive
* Perfect for long survival sessions and relaxed gameplay
* Simple drag-and-drop installation

## ⚠️ Optional Deep Dark Music Add-On

An optional file named **`DeepDarkSoundtrack.zip`** is included separately.

Without this add-on, the **Deep Dark biome will have no music at all**.

If you want Deep Dark music enabled:

1. Install `DeepDarkSoundtrack.zip`
2. Place it **above** `Music From C418` in the Resource Packs menu

The add-on must stay higher in priority order to work correctly.

## 📦 Installation

1. Download the pack
2. Open Minecraft
3. Go to **Options → Resource Packs**
4. Add the pack and enable it
5. Enjoy the classic soundtrack experience
